headline: Colonial Gains Sweep Islands While Weathered Expanse and Central Fronts Boil
war_summary: Since the previous edition, island fighting has produced significant shifts as Colonials expanded control across Godcrofts to hold eight strongpoints against one Warden base, while securing all nine positions in Oarbreaker following fresh captures at Gold and Grisly Refuge. Weathered Expanse continues as the war's most volatile sector, recording eleven strategic base events in the past two hours around Wightwalk and Spirit Watch, leaving one base neutral amidst over twenty-eight hundred recent casualties. In Stonecradle, direct base contestation resumed with three transitions in the two-hour window alongside heavy attrition exceeding twenty-one hundred fallen. Stlican Shelf saw base turnover moderate to two events over the same span. While territorial lines held static across Dead Lands, Farranac Coast, and Linn of Mercy during the latest two hours, intense bloodshed persisted, most notably in Callahan's Passage, which suffered a sudden casualty surge of nearly thirty-five hundred men.
